years.definition: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.

yelled.definition: To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yelling.definition: To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yellow.definition: The color of sunflower petals and lemons; the color obtained by mixing green and red light, or by subtracting blue from white light; the color evoked by light of wavelength around 580 nm; one of the three primary colors in subtractive color systems.

yellowing.definition: The color of sunflower petals and lemons; the color obtained by mixing green and red light, or by subtracting blue from white light; the color evoked by light of wavelength around 580 nm; one of the three primary colors in subtractive color systems.

yer.definition: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yew.definition: A species of coniferous tree, Taxus baccata, with dark-green flat needle-like leaves and seeds bearing red arils, native to western, central and southern Europe, northwest Africa, northern Iran and southwest Asia.

yews.definition: A species of coniferous tree, Taxus baccata, with dark-green flat needle-like leaves and seeds bearing red arils, native to western, central and southern Europe, northwest Africa, northern Iran and southwest Asia.

yielding.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yis.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

younger.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youngest.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

youth’s.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zest.definition: The outer skin of a citrus fruit, used as a flavouring or garnish.
